note: Commands Muse queues for the infused ThundR float. The page polls this file, executes pending items it has not run yet, and tracks executed ids in localStorage. The page cannot write back to the repo: Muse rotates the queue (marks items done / removes them) on the next push. Queued commands run through the SAME router and the SAME refuse rules as typed commands — the queue is not a trust channel; a queued `mint` is refused exactly as a typed `mint` is.
